entries.subject: Hartley 2 EPOXI normalization using Li 2013 Hapke parameters
entries.finding: The diagnostic trial reduces accepted photographed area from 57.98% to 32.00%; 8 of 10 common-point overlap pairs improve. The source-sampler view replaces much photographed terrain with grid. Retain the observed photographs. The original H-function approximation is unverified and normalization does not remove foreground coma.
entries.revisitWhen: A verified model formulation and treatment of illumination or coma can improve overlaps while retaining the photographed terrain.

entries.subject: PDS Hartley 2 shape and constraint flags
entries.finding: The original 16,022-vertex, 32,040-triangle mesh supplies the retained shape. Stereo, limb and weak-region flags support the source-constraint view. The encounter long axis is not a spin pole, and the scene does not reconstruct tumbling.

entries.subject: MRI 6000001, 6000002 and 6000003
entries.finding: The three clear-filter MRI photographs fill accepted terrain beyond the HRI footprints in the combined EPOXI mosaic. Original illumination remains and weak source shape is excluded.

entries.subject: HRI 5004004 and 5004008, 50-iteration restoration
entries.finding: The mission-restored HRI images provide finer accepted sampling in the same EPOXI view. The 3.9–4.5 m detector sampling is not a claim of resolved terrain at that scale; grain and ringing remain.

entries.subject: Higher-iteration HRI restorations
entries.finding: The examined higher iteration counts add grain, and the archive warns of noise amplification in already-converged regions. Extra grain was not accepted as additional measured terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: An independent resolution and noise comparison demonstrates useful surface information beyond the selected restoration.

entries.subject: Softer 25-iteration HRI alternative
entries.finding: The 25-iteration product remains a softer candidate; it was not selected over the current 50-iteration version.
entries.revisitWhen: A matched comparison shows a useful reduction in restoration artifacts without losing required surface detail.

entries.subject: Closer HRI images outside most of the nucleus
entries.finding: Several surveyed closer frames miss most of the nucleus. Stars, jets and ice grains outside the body were not treated as surface texture; the note does not preserve individual rejected frame IDs.
entries.revisitWhen: A specifically identified frame has a valid nucleus footprint that adds useful coverage or detail.

entries.subject: Separate MRI and HRI photographic menu choices
entries.finding: The compatible short-encounter photographs were combined into one EPOXI view. Their recorded ten overlaps support the visual composite; separate rows duplicated complementary parts of one encounter.
entries.revisitWhen: An observational or scientific difference makes separate views useful instead of duplicating the same encounter mosaic.

entries.subject: HRI-IR V3 fitted color temperature
entries.finding: The selected 57-exposure scan supplies fitted temperature on 757 accepted source facets. This is a new fit to V3 spectra with approximate placement, not the earlier paper's map or its quoted error bars.

entries.subject: HRI-IR V3 reflected continuum slope
entries.finding: The same detector mask supports reflected spectral slope across 1.5–2.2 micrometres. It does not identify minerals or measure surface gradients, and unqualified spectra remain grid.

entries.subject: Other inbound and outbound HRI-IR scans
entries.finding: Other scans remain candidates. The chosen scan's relative placement, spectral fit and coma limitations do not qualify the rest of the encounter.
entries.revisitWhen: A specific scan adds useful source facets with independently checked registration and valid nucleus spectra.

entries.subject: Dryad Hartley spectra as a substitute for PDS V3
entries.finding: The retained investigation found a calibration difference between the Dryad copies and PDS V3. The current fields restore the calibrated observations directly from PDS rather than silently exchanging calibrations.
entries.revisitWhen: The exact calibration relationship is established and a separately versioned preparation can be qualified.

entries.subject: Dryad thermal-model arrays as observed temperature
entries.finding: The arrays are modeled temperatures. They were not substituted for fits to the observed spectra.
entries.revisitWhen: A clearly identified model-comparison view is justified using the model's actual assumptions and geometry.

entries.subject: Waist and smooth terrain places
entries.finding: Thomas 2013 Figs. 3 and 7 supply three approximate mapped places in the PDS frame. Published panel centers and a representative elongated-region point are not official named centers or precise boundaries.
